title: Henge
body:
Syntax: perform henge <target>

Description: Disguise yourself as a person in the room; casting without a target removes your disguise. Take the appearance of a person in this room. Use without a target to release your disguise; higher Henge tiers last longer. Usable with any chakra nature. Illusion lasts 12 pulses. Unlocks at level 5. Costs 12 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
